content_sections.heading: GSSSB Food Safety Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for GSSSB FSO Recruitment 2026 must meet the educational qualification, age limit, computer knowledge and language requirements prescribed under the Food Safety Officer recruitment rules. The notification recognises qualifications in Chemistry, Food Technology, Agriculture-related sciences, Medicine and other specified disciplines. The GSSSB Food Safety Officer notification permits candidates with a Master's Degree in Chemistry or an eligible degree in the prescribed scientific and professional disciplines to apply. Certain additional Bachelor's, Master's and Doctorate qualifications are also recognised under the applicable Central Government notification, subject to the specified equivalence conditions. In addition to the principal qualifications, the recruitment notice recognises several related disciplines under the applicable Food Safety Officer qualification rules. Candidates possessing the following qualifications may be eligible if their degree level and exact course title satisfy the official requirements. Note: Candidates must verify their exact academic qualification against the official notification. Merely having a similarly named course does not automatically establish eligibility. Along with the prescribed educational qualification, candidates must possess basic knowledge of computer applications under the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both is also required. The recruitment rules further specify that a person with a financial interest in the manufacture, import or sale of any article of food cannot be appointed as a Food Safety Officer. Note: The application deadline has been extended, but the OJAS screenshot does not specify whether the original age calculation date has changed. Candidates should check the official extension or corrigendum for any modification to the eligibility cut-off. The regular GSSSB FSO recruitment notification provides upper age relaxation to eligible reserved-category candidates and other specified groups. Different relaxation limits apply depending on gender, reservation category and disability status.

content_sections.text: The GSSSB Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026 application fee is Rs.500 for unreserved candidates who do not qualify for a concessional fee. A reduced fee of Rs.400 applies to specified categories, including women, SEBC, SC, ST, EWS, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates. The examination fee must be paid online through the OJAS Gujarat portal. Payment Mode: Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or Wallet through the OJAS online payment facility. content_sections.heading: GSSSB Food Safety Officer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The GSSSB Food Safety Officer Salary 2026 is Rs.40,800 per month on a fixed-pay basis for the first five years. After completing five years of satisfactory service, selected candidates may become eligible for regular appointment under Pay Level 5, with a pay scale of Rs.29,200 to Rs.92,300, subject to applicable Gujarat Government resolutions and the conditions mentioned in the notification. The notification states that regular appointment after the initial five-year period is subject to satisfactory service, applicable Government resolutions and the outcome of the referenced Supreme Court proceedings.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Food Safety Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The GSSSB Food Safety Officer Selection Process 2026 includes a competitive objective examination followed by merit-based shortlisting and document verification. The examination will be conducted through the Computer Based Response Test (CBRT) or OMR method. The question paper contains Part A and Part B, with a total of 210 questions carrying 210 marks. Candidates will appear for a competitive examination covering Logical Reasoning, Data Interpretation, Mathematics, the Indian Constitution, Current Affairs, Gujarati and English comprehension, and the relevant technical subject. The examination carries 210 marks and has a duration of three hours. Candidates must secure a minimum of 40% marks separately in Part A and Part B. The minimum qualifying standard of 40% applies to all categories according to the official notification. GSSSB will publish the provisional examination results and prepare a merit-based shortlist. Candidates shortlisted according to the recruitment rules will be required to produce their original educational, category, disability and other relevant documents for verification. The final selection and waiting lists will be prepared based on examination merit, verification of qualifications and compliance with the applicable reservation and recruitment rules.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Food Safety Officer Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The GSSSB Food Safety Officer Exam Pattern 2026 consists of a single objective examination divided into Part A and Part B. The paper contains 210 multiple-choice questions carrying 210 marks. Candidates will have three hours to complete the examination, and negative marking applies to incorrect answers. Exam Duration: 180 Minutes (3 Hours). Negative Marking: 0.25 marks for each incorrect one-mark question. Minimum Qualifying Marks: 40% separately in Part A and Part B.
